description: Wire CustomizeView to use the new stores and shared UI components as a proof-of-concept, demonstrating the new architecture works alongside existing code. Also wire CheatingDaddyApp to use session-store for route-independent sessions.
steps: Add script tag for src/components/ui/index.js in src/index.html as type=module, placed after the lit-core script src but before the CheatingDaddyApp.js script. This registers all custom elements globally.
Add script tag for src/stores/index.js in src/index.html as type=module, placed right after the ui components import. This initializes stores early.

In CustomizeView.js, add import of settingsStore from '../../stores/settings-store.js'. In connectedCallback() subscribe to settingsStore: store changes update local properties (backgroundTransparency, hotkeyToastsEnabled, theme). In disconnectedCallback() unsubscribe.

In CustomizeView.js renderAppearanceSection(), replace the background transparency raw input[type=range] with <cd-slider .value=${this.backgroundTransparency} min='0' max='1' step='0.01' label='Background Transparency' unit='%' @slider-input=${handler}></cd-slider>. The handler should call both the existing updatePreference logic AND settingsStore.set({backgroundTransparency: value}).

In CustomizeView.js renderAppearanceSection(), replace the hotkeyToasts checkbox with <cd-toggle .checked=${this.hotkeyToastsEnabled} label='Show hotkey notifications' @toggle-change=${handler}></cd-toggle>. Handler calls existing logic + settingsStore.set({hotkeyToastsEnabled: value}).

In CustomizeView.js renderAppearanceSection(), replace the theme <select> with <cd-select .value=${this.theme} .options=${this.getThemes()} label='Theme' @select-change=${handler}></cd-select>. Handler calls existing handleThemeChange logic.

In CheatingDaddyApp.js, add import of sessionStore from '../../stores/session-store.js'. In constructor or connectedCallback, subscribe to sessionStore. When session state changes (active/provider/profile), update the sessionActive property from the store. This makes session state survive navigation.

Ensure all existing functionality continues to work - the stores are additive, existing IPC paths still function. The CustomizeView changes are purely UI component swaps with the same underlying behavior.
Run npx prettier --write on all modified files.
acceptance_criteria: CustomizeView uses cd-slider for background transparency
CustomizeView uses cd-toggle for hotkey toasts
CustomizeView uses cd-select for theme selection
CustomizeView subscribes to settingsStore and reacts to external state changes
CheatingDaddyApp imports and subscribes to sessionStore
Existing functionality is preserved - all IPC handlers still work, views still render
src/index.html includes script tags for stores and ui components
No breaking changes to any other view
verification: Verify src/index.html includes type=module script tags for stores/index.js and components/ui/index.js
Verify CustomizeView.js imports settingsStore and uses cd-slider, cd-toggle, cd-select
Verify no syntax errors: node --check on all main-process files, ES module parse check on renderer files
Run npx prettier --write . and confirm no remaining formatting issues
findings: All three files modified and verified via bun transpilation (no node available). Prettier formatted CustomizeView.js and CheatingDaddyApp.js. Script tags added to index.html after CheatingDaddyApp.js but before <cheating-daddy-app>. Store subscriptions added to both CustomizeView (settingsStore) and CheatingDaddyApp (sessionStore) with proper unsubscribe in disconnectedCallback. Existing handlers preserved alongside new store-based handlers.
